notes: Conference overview (Mater. Res. Soc. Symp. Proc. 885E) by DOE program staff describing the structure, targets and recent progress of the National Hydrogen Storage Project. Figures 1-7 are taken from other projects or references (Figure 1 [1], Figure 3 [7], Figure 4 [8,9], Figure 5 theoretical [11], Figure 6 [12], Figure 7 Air Products). Figure 3 (attributed to Sandia-Livermore [7]) is a pressure-composition plot for lithium/magnesium amide, a hydride and not a carbon sorbent; Figures 4, 6 and 7 show a reaction scheme, thermal desorption of ammonia borane and cyclic desorption from N-ethyl carbazole, none of them H2 uptake by a carbon sorbent.
